judge.rationale: The candidate implements the exact same `accumulateUsage` logic and `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` hook signature rename as the reference, satisfying all acceptance criteria including explicitly documenting why the per-round breakdown shape was rejected. It thoroughly tests multi-round accumulation and partial `undefined` usage across rounds using a scripted provider. It differs slightly from the reference by placing `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` and adding a separate `usage.acceptance.test.ts` file instead of extending `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Additionally, the candidate leaves the internal local variable named `lastUsage` in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, omits the doc sync in `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, and includes minor extraneous changes to `package.json` and `mongoTestSupport.ts`.
